mission: 把感觉输入、神经编码与传导、中枢状态/整合、运动控制、神经肌肉产力和骨关节承载压缩成一个可反向定位的‘信息—控制—执行—结构—反馈’系统，同时把创伤、压迫、缺血、退变、感染、炎症、畸形和肿瘤造成的结构失效纳入同一判断语言：先定位故障层和当前危险，再用分布、反射/肌张力、受力与稳定性、神经血管状态、影像/病理和功能目标缩小诊断与处理方向，而不是从症状或单一影像征直接猜病名。

mental_model.mother_model: 外界/身体状态被感受器换能并编码 → 神经纤维把信号传入 → 突触与受体筛选/整合 → 中枢网络维持觉醒与内部状态并形成感觉、行为和运动方案 → 下行控制与运动神经把命令送至神经肌肉接头 → 骨骼肌把电化学信号转成力 → 骨、关节、肌腱、韧带和筋膜把力变成稳定动作与承重 → 本体/痛觉/视觉/前庭反馈持续校正。与此同时，创伤、压迫、缺血、过载、感染、免疫炎症、发育异常或肿瘤可在任一神经/结构层制造新的故障；诊断必须先定位故障层、稳定性和危险结构，再进入具体病名。
spine: Sensor / Transduction：刺激性质、感受器、受体电位与感觉编码
Wire：轴突、髓鞘、神经根、周围神经与脊髓长束负责保真传导
Gate：突触、递质与受体决定兴奋/抑制、总和和调制
State / Controller：脑干—丘脑—皮层、基底节、小脑、觉醒/高级功能与下丘脑形成网络状态和行为/运动方案
Command：皮层/脑干下行系统与α/γ运动神经元组织反射、肌张力和随意运动
Actuator：NMJ、肌膜、三联管、Ca²⁺和横桥把命令转成可调节的肌力
Plant：骨、关节、软骨、肌腱、韧带、筋膜和椎间盘维持对位、稳定、传力与承重
Feedback：本体感觉、痛觉、视觉与前庭不断校正动作，并提示结构危险
Repair / Adaptation：炎症、血供、骨折愈合、重塑和功能锻炼决定损伤后能否恢复稳定与功能
loops: 感觉—定位环：刺激 → 换能/编码 → 传导 → 中枢投射 → 感觉/体征 → 由分布、反射与平面反推故障层
运动—反馈环：目标/状态 → 中枢策划协调 → 下行命令 → NMJ/肌肉产力 → 骨关节动作 → 本体/视觉/前庭反馈 → 在线修正
结构—修复环：外力/过载/缺血/感染/炎症/肿瘤 → 结构失稳或破坏 → 疼痛/神经血管风险 → 复位/减压/清创/固定/病因控制 → 愈合重塑 → 功能恢复/重新承重

core_relations: pain, numbness and weakness are entry symptoms, not diagnoses; first localize neural versus structural level before selecting a disease label
axonal conduction, synaptic transmission, transmitter/receptor effect and central network integration are different failure layers and cannot substitute for one another
all sensory systems share transduction–encoding–projection logic, while vision, hearing and vestibular physiology add organ-specific mechanics that must remain source-bound
motor output is a closed control loop: central planning/coordination, descending command, spinal/reflex control, NMJ/muscle force and sensory feedback are distinct but coupled layers

a painful or mechanically unstable limb can appear weak without a primary neural motor lesion; neurologic localization requires distribution, tone, reflexes, pathologic signs, sensation and sphincter context
UMN versus LMN, cord versus conus/cauda, root versus named peripheral nerve and acute spinal-shock timing are separate discriminations; one sign cannot complete the localization
orthopedic trauma is judged by life/limb threat, open contamination, neurovascular status, structural stability, alignment, blood supply/soft tissue and functional goal—not by fracture name alone

O2 fracture principles are reusable common mechanics; regional fractures add local force direction, muscle pull, blood supply, joint congruity and neighboring neurovascular risk rather than re-teaching the whole general model
spine/nerve disease is organized by the compressed object: root, cord, cauda or named peripheral nerve; acute trauma/instability and chronic degenerative space loss are different causal models

imaging has a question-specific role: plain radiography, CT and MRI answer different structural/soft-tissue/localization questions; a visual gate cannot be replaced by prose when the decisive evidence is spatial
avascular necrosis is a perfusion/repair-under-load model rather than an infectious model; collapse status changes the treatment objective
chronic overload and entrapment are cumulative load/space failures rather than a single acute rupture; the learner must localize the repeatedly stressed tissue or fixed compression space

bone/joint infection combines organ-specific anatomy with the shared pathogen–host–source-control model; C owns common infection language while D owns orthopedic site, dead bone/dead space and structural consequences
RA immune/medical Primary remains in C; D owns only the source-supported orthopedic structural/functional coordinates and comparison with OA/AS
bone-tumor reasoning proceeds from aggressiveness, age, bone/site, matrix/periosteal reaction and extent to pathology confirmation; tumor-general and myeloma clonal Primary remain with their owners
Block-level Source conflicts and legacy exam wording are evidence constraints, not invitations for model-common-sense correction
failure_modes: 刺激存在但感受器换能、适应、频率/空间编码或器官特异机械过程失真
轴突、髓鞘、神经根、周围神经或脊髓通路中断，使信号不能保真到达目标
递质释放、受体效应、兴奋/抑制与网络总和异常，导致局部或广泛神经功能改变
中枢网络状态/高级整合失败
觉醒、睡眠、学习记忆、语言或下丘脑整合接口异常；当前仅限Source支持范围
运动控制与定位层级失衡
皮层/脑干/基底节/小脑/脊髓/UMN-LMN层级故障造成反射、肌张力、姿势、协调或随意运动异常
NMJ、兴奋—收缩耦联、Ca²⁺或横桥/运动单位不能把神经命令稳定转成力
骨折、脱位、韧带/半月板/肌腱等急性损伤破坏对位、关节匹配或承重并可牵连神经血管
神经血管/灌注与空间危险
血供中断、骨筋膜室高压、脊髓/马尾受压或高位神经损伤造成时间敏感的组织/功能威胁
感染、血供差、固定/稳定问题或长期制动使骨/软组织出现延迟愈合、不愈合、畸形愈合、僵硬或继发退变
重复负荷、狭窄空间、软骨/椎间盘退变或力线异常逐步造成疼痛、神经卡压和功能下降
儿童生长与负重把结构偏差放大并逐渐固定，治疗窗口受年龄和可塑性影响
感染/免疫炎症性结构破坏
化脓感染、结核或免疫炎症破坏骨、关节、滑膜/附着点并可形成脓腔、死骨、畸形或神经压迫
原发或转移性骨病改变骨质、皮质/骨膜和软组织边界，导致疼痛、肿块、病理骨折或神经压迫
judgment_axes: Source-supported neural physiology / localization vs unsupported complete clinical neurology
transduction/encoding vs axonal conduction vs synaptic/receptor vs central-network failure
central/cord vs root vs named peripheral nerve vs NMJ/muscle vs pain-limited structural weakness
UMN vs LMN; cord vs conus vs cauda; acute spinal shock vs established long-tract pattern
acute unstable trauma vs chronic degenerative/compressive disease
bone vs joint vs soft tissue vs nerve vs vascular structure as the first failed object
open vs closed; stable vs unstable; aligned/congruent vs displaced; neurovascular intact vs threatened
upper-limb positioning/hand function vs lower-limb weight-bearing/blood-supply/function priorities
mechanical/degenerative vs ischemic vs infectious vs immune-inflammatory vs developmental vs neoplastic cause
pyogenic infection vs TB; local source-control problem vs shared systemic infection language
OA cartilage-degeneration vs AS axial/enthesis pattern vs RA synovial/systemic immune Primary
benign/slow versus aggressive/malignant bone lesion using age–site–matrix/periosteal reaction–pathology evidence stack
stable semantic rule vs disputed Source precision that must remain explicit rather than silently reconciled

block_families.label: 神经信号底座与肌肉执行器
block_families.role: 建立从轴突传导、突触/受体到NMJ和骨骼肌产力的共同执行语言

block_families.label: 感觉共同语言与特殊感觉
block_families.role: 建立换能/编码/投射共同模型，并完成Current Source支持的视觉、听觉、前庭、痛觉接口

block_families.label: 中枢运动、网络状态与神经定位
block_families.role: 从反射/肌张力/运动控制推进到睡眠觉醒、高级功能/下丘脑，并将前述生理压成最小可运行定位桥梁

block_families.label: 骨科共同入口、骨折与神经结构风险
block_families.role: 先建立结构—稳定—危险—功能和骨折共同框架，再处理脊柱/压迫/周围神经及上下肢部位特异创伤

block_families.label: 局部软组织、缺血、慢性负荷与发育结构
block_families.role: 处理手/膝特异损伤、股骨头血供、慢性过载/卡压和发育畸形等独立结构模型

block_families.label: 感染、炎症与骨肿瘤
block_families.role: 调用上游共同感染/免疫/肿瘤语言，只完成骨关节器官特异结构、影像、源控制与功能后果

inputs: A1 Circulation: perfusion/shock, thrombosis/ischemia, neurovascular threat and tissue-blood-supply interfaces
A2 Respiratory: ventilatory-pump/high-cervical-cord consequences and respiratory-failure interfaces
A3 Urinary: bladder/autonomic consequences of cord injury, renal/electrolyte effects on neurologic state and medication interfaces
B Digestive/Metabolic/Endocrine/Tumor: ATP/Ca²⁺ muscle-energy language, Ca/P/PTH/VitD and growth/endocrine bone interfaces, glucocorticoid/AVN and B12-neurologic interfaces, tumor-molecular language
C Hematology/Immunity/Infection: common infection/source-control/TB language, RA immune Primary, vasculitic neuropathy interfaces, myeloma bone disease and systemic inflammatory/infectious danger
O9 Tumor General: tumor behavior, invasion/metastasis and general morphology language where O16 explicitly calls the gate
outputs: E Reproductive/Breast: hypothalamic–pituitary/autonomic interfaces and pelvic/cord injury sexual/reproductive-function interfaces
F Remaining Clinical: neurotransmitter/receptor and NMJ interfaces for poisoning/anesthesia, pain/consciousness monitoring, trauma/perioperative and functional-recovery entry
all Systems: minimum neurologic localization language, neurovascular red flags, mobility/weight-bearing/function coordinates and recognition of when structural disease is the true owner
external_interfaces.rule: Interfaces name only what is recalled/applied across Current owners. They do not authorize finer external Block/KP routing unless a separate reviewed Current owner provides it.
